items.difficulty_reason: H3: the model-specific proof constructs uniform bounded-type Birkhoff lower/upper bounds and p!=q second-order splitting, then handles unbalanced and near-resonant orbit distances to create a definite cocycle drift persisting over long intervals. These quantitative constructions establish the main Ratner dichotomy and disjointness of integer rescalings; the existing abstract1917criterion alone does not contain them. The full core is counted as one family, not separate lemma questions.
